If the domain is 1492 (when Europe moves to QAD), take the EU DBC and multiply it by the exchange rate included in the XML from Model N to TPT/OE.  If the domain is 4543, take the AP DBC and multiply it by the exchange rate included in the XML from Model N to TPT/OE.  If the domain is X, Y, Z, need to make sure the correct DBC is being used from the XML.  The XML always sends the DBC for all three regions.
